resources.string: Sign in and manage your Vinz Account
Sign in to your Vinz Account with email and password. YouTube Music has its own separate login. Local music and playback work without signing in.
If an account exists for this address, a recovery email has been sent.
Your recovery link is verified. Choose a new password.
Your recovery link is verified. Set a new password for your Vinz Account.
Your Vinz Account password has been updated.
Enter the same new password again.
Your email still needs verification. Check your inbox for the latest code.
Enter the six-digit code sent to %1$s to finish verifying your Vinz Account.
Codes expire according to your account security settings. If a code expires, request a new one.
We sent a verification code to your email. Enter it to continue.
A new verification code has been sent.
That code is invalid or expired. Check it or request a new one.
Too many attempts or requests. Wait before trying again.
Email verification could not be completed. Check the code and try again.
A new code could not be sent. Wait before trying again.
Visible only to you. It is not shown on your public music profile.
Your private account details are saved.
Your private account details could not be saved. Try again.
Allow other Vinz users to view your profile.
Allow your profile to appear in user discovery.
You have signed out of your cloud account.
Your profile could not be loaded. Try again before editing.
This account request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
Sign-in could not be completed. Check your details and connection, then try again.
Your profile could not be saved. Check your details and connection, then try again.
The recovery request could not be completed. Try again later.
Sign-out could not be completed. Try again.
Enter the email address for your Vinz Account.
